<ParamField body="aria-hidden" type="Booleanish">
  Explicitly hides or exposes the character. Takes precedence over the name-based default.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-label" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="aria-labelledby" type="string">
  ID of an element naming a standalone character. Adds the image role.
</ParamField>
